- $1.3bn, ~138% premium to the Oct 9 unaffected close, ~119% premium to 30-day VWAP).

- Price has been pinned in a $5.94–$5.98 band all session. No spread, no chase, no momentum.

- Per the skill's buyout rule, a name trading tight to stated cash terms is **sideways merger-arb spread, not a tradeable gap**.
- Excluded from Tier A / Soft-A / B despite being the #1 headline mover on the tape.
- The correct expression is an arb position sized to deal-break risk, not a long-bias breakout entry. There is no edge available to a momentum trader at $5.96.
